title: DriveAnchor: Progressive Anchor-based Flow Learning for Autonomous Driving Planning
summary: We present DriveAnchor, a three-stage framework for autonomous driving planning that achieves behavioral diversity, controllability, and safety in a composable pipeline. Demonstration Flow Pretraining replaces the unstructured Gaussian prior with a vocabulary of 2,398 trajectory shapes constructed by farthest-point sampling, structurally grounding behavioral diversity in vocabulary coverage. Guided Flow Post-training jointly post-trains an Energy Field module with flow matching (FM), conditioning the Energy Field on static road geometry alone, to relocate anchors toward user-specified corridor polygons before flow generation, adding controllability without differentiable guidance; after Stage 2, new corridor presets require only Energy Field updates, not FM retraining. Reward-Refined Flow Fine-tuning applies zeroth-order reinforcement learning to align each anchor's output with collision-avoidance objectives: because the flow-matching model is a deterministic feedforward network in single-step mode, each anchor uniquely determines the output trajectory, reducing reward optimization to a direction search in anchor space without log-likelihood computation or ODE-to-SDE conversion. Evaluated on approximately 2 million held-out driving scenarios, DriveAnchor reduces near-range collision rates by 89% and improves mean reward by 32% without degradation in imitation accuracy, with 2.06 ms inference on NVIDIA Drive Orin. DriveAnchor has been validated through real-world vehicle testing, confirming its practicality for production deployment.
tldr: DriveAnchor is a three-stage autonomous driving planning framework that uses anchor-based flow learning to achieve diverse, controllable, and safe trajectory planning, validated on real vehicles.
tldr_zh: DriveAnchor 是一个三阶段自动驾驶规划框架，通过基于锚点的流学习实现多样、可控且安全的轨迹规划，并已在实车上验证。
summary_zh: 我们提出了DriveAnchor——一个用于自动驾驶规划的三阶段框架，通过可组合的流水线实现行为多样性、可控性与安全性。演示流预训练阶段利用最远点采样构建包含2,398种轨迹形态的词汇表，取代非结构化高斯先验，从根本上将行为多样性锚定于词汇覆盖范围。引导流后训练阶段联合训练能量场模块与流匹配（FM），仅依据静态道路几何条件约束能量场，在流生成前将锚点重定位至用户指定的走廊多边形，无需可微引导即可实现可控性；第二阶段完成后，新的走廊预设仅需更新能量场，无需重新训练FM。奖励精炼流微调阶段应用零阶强化学习，将每个锚点的输出与避撞目标对齐：由于流匹配模型在单步模式下为确定性前馈网络，每个锚点唯一确定输出轨迹，从而将奖励优化简化为锚点空间中的方向搜索，无需对数似然计算或ODE-SDE转换。在约200万个预留驾驶场景上的评估表明，DriveAnchor将近距离碰撞率降低89%，平均奖励提升32%，且不降低模仿精度，在NVIDIA Drive Orin上推理耗时2.06毫秒。DriveAnchor已通过实车测试验证，确认其具备量产部署的实用性。

title: SafeVLA-Bench: A Benchmark for the Success-Safety Gap in Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) benchmarks measure whether a policy completes a requested manipulation task, but binary success can hide safety-relevant trajectory behavior: reaching the goal while applying excessive contact, disturbing bystander objects, destabilizing the held object, or entering robot self-contact. We present SafeVLA-Bench, a post-hoc safety-evaluation framework for existing simulator-based VLA benchmarks. It formalizes task-aware safety requirements as Signal Temporal Logic (STL) specifications and reports native success with two unsafe-success metrics: Succ-But-Unsafe (SBU), the fraction of rollouts that both succeed and violate safety, and Violation Severity Index (VSI), a bounded worst-violation depth score. We instantiate SafeVLA-Bench on LIBERO and RoboCasa-365, evaluating nine policy-benchmark entries across tabletop and kitchen manipulation tasks. High task success does not imply safe execution: high-SR tabletop baselines still leave 13 to 15 percent unsafe-episode rates,and 36 to 56 percent of successful RoboCasa-365 rollouts violate at least one active safety clause. Project page: https://safevla.org.
tldr: SafeVLA-Bench is a benchmark that evaluates the safety of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models by measuring unsafe successful executions, revealing a success-safety gap where high task success rates coexist with non-negligible safety violations.
tldr_zh: SafeVLA-Bench是一个评估视觉-语言-动作模型安全性的基准，通过衡量任务成功但存在安全违规的执行，揭示了高成功率与不可忽视的安全违规之间的差距。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）基准测试用于衡量策略是否完成指定的操作任务，但二元化的成功标准可能隐藏与安全相关的轨迹行为：在达成目标的同时施加过大接触力、干扰周围物体、导致抓取物体失稳或引发机器人自身接触。我们提出SafeVLA-Bench——一个面向现有基于模拟器的VLA基准测试的事后安全评估框架。该框架将任务感知的安全需求形式化为信号时序逻辑（STL）规范，并采用两种不安全成功指标报告原生成功率：成功但不安全（SBU），即既成功又违反安全规则的轨迹占比；以及违规严重性指数（VSI），即约束条件下的最坏违规深度评分。我们在LIBERO和RoboCasa-365上实例化SafeVLA-Bench，评估了涵盖桌面操作和厨房操作任务的九个策略基准条目。高任务成功率并不等同于安全执行：高成功率的桌面基准仍有13%至15%的不安全轨迹率，而RoboCasa-365中36%至56%的成功轨迹至少违反一条活跃安全条款。项目页面：https://safevla.org。

title: SKIP: Sparse Keyframe Interpolation Paradigm for Efficient Embodied World Models
summary: Embodied world models have emerged as a promising paradigm in robotics by predicting how robot actions affect the surrounding scene. However, the rollout inference remains computationally expensive in pixel space, as long-horizon manipulation videos typically have to be generated frame by frame. This cost cannot be easily reduced by indiscriminately dropping frames, since downstream policies rely on complete preservation of sparse task-relevant events such as approach, contact, grasp, and release. To address this challenge, we propose Sparse Keyframe Interpolation Paradigm (SKIP), an event-preserving sparse-to-dense framework that avoids dense frame-by-frame generation. SKIP first identifies task-relevant keyframes by leveraging robot-aware multimodal features. It then synthesizes only these keyframes with a sparse video diffusion model. A learned gap predictor and an action-conditioned interpolator subsequently reconstruct the missing intervals according to the robot actions. On LIBERO, SKIP generates dense rollouts $4.16\times$ faster than a dense baseline while improving visual fidelity and reducing aggregate FVD by $89.0\%$. Importantly, SKIP-generated videos are effective policy-training data. Even when they fully replace real demonstrations, $π_{0.5}$ success drops only $1.3$ pp in LIBERO simulation and $6.7$ pp on the real robot, whereas fully dense frame-by-frame generation collapses by $48$ to $58$ pp.
tldr: SKIP proposes a sparse-to-dense video generation framework that identifies and synthesizes only task-relevant keyframes, then interpolates missing frames conditioned on robot actions, achieving 4.16× speedup in world model rollout while preserving policy-training utility.
tldr_zh: SKIP提出了一种稀疏到密集的视频生成框架，仅识别并合成任务相关的关键帧，然后基于机器人动作插值缺失帧，在世界模型推演中实现4.16倍加速，同时保留策略训练的有效性。
summary_zh: 具身世界模型通过预测机器人动作如何影响周围场景，已成为机器人学中一种极具前景的范式。然而，在像素空间中进行长程推演推理的计算成本依然高昂，因为操作视频通常需要逐帧生成。由于下游策略依赖于对稀疏任务相关事件（如接近、接触、抓取和释放）的完整保留，因此无法通过不加区分地丢弃帧来轻易降低这一成本。为应对这一挑战，我们提出稀疏关键帧插值范式（SKIP），这是一种保留事件的稀疏到稠密框架，避免了密集的逐帧生成。SKIP 首先利用机器人感知的多模态特征识别任务相关的关键帧，随后仅通过稀疏视频扩散模型合成这些关键帧，再借助学习到的间隔预测器与动作条件插值器，根据机器人动作重构缺失的时间间隔。在 LIBERO 上，SKIP 生成密集推演序列的速度比密集基线方法快 4.16 倍，同时提升了视觉保真度，并将聚合 FVD 降低 89.0%。更重要的是，SKIP 生成的视频是有效的策略训练数据。即使完全替代真实演示，$π_{0.5}$ 在 LIBERO 仿真中的成功率仅下降 1.3 个百分点，在真实机器人上下降 6.7 个百分点，而完全密集的逐帧生成方法则下降 48 至 58 个百分点。

title: Global-Local Attention Decomposition for Terrain Encoding in Humanoid Perceptive Locomotion
summary: Although reinforcement learning has significantly advanced humanoid locomotion, perceptive policies still struggle on sparse-foothold terrain and constrained environments. Success in these scenarios requires both broad terrain awareness and precise foothold selection, two perceptual roles that conventional encoders often entangle. To address this challenge, we propose Global-Local Attention Decomposition (GLAD) for terrain encoding in humanoid locomotion. Realized by a coarse-to-fine encoder over a robot-centric elevation map, GLAD explicitly separates these objectives: a global attention branch utilizes attention pooling to summarize the surrounding terrain context, while a state-conditioned local attention branch sparsifies and encodes precise foothold-relevant geometry. This explicit attention decomposition prevents the dilution of fine-grained spatial cues while reducing training overhead. Experiments demonstrate that GLAD enables reliable locomotion over challenging gaps, stepping stones, and stairs. Furthermore, the learned policy exhibits emergent terrain-responsive behaviors, autonomously following narrow paths and avoiding obstacles under simple velocity commands without explicit navigation planners. In real-world deployment on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot using onboard LiDAR, the proposed method achieves robust zero-shot sim-to-real transfer across diverse sparse-foothold and obstacle-rich domains.
tldr: Proposes Global-Local Attention Decomposition (GLAD), a coarse-to-fine terrain encoder for humanoid locomotion that explicitly separates global context and local foothold geometry, enabling robust zero-shot sim-to-real deployment on a Unitree G1 robot.
tldr_zh: 提出全局-局部注意力分解（GLAD），一种用于人形机器人运动的粗到细地形编码器，明确分离全局上下文和局部立足点几何，在Unitree G1机器人上实现稳健的零样本仿真到现实迁移。
summary_zh: 虽然强化学习已显著推进了仿人机器人运动能力的发展，但在稀疏立足点地形和受限环境中，感知策略仍面临困难。要在这些场景中取得成功，需要同时具备广阔的地形感知能力和精确的立足点选择能力——这两种感知功能在传统编码器中往往相互纠缠。针对这一挑战，我们提出用于仿人机器人地形编码的全局-局部注意力分解方法（GLAD）。该方法通过基于机器人中心高程地图的由粗到精编码器，明确分离了上述目标：全局注意力分支利用注意力池化汇总周围地形上下文信息，而状态条件化的局部注意力分支则稀疏化并编码与立足点相关的精确几何特征。这种显式注意力分解在降低训练开销的同时，避免了细粒度空间线索的稀释。实验表明，GLAD能使机器人在具有挑战性的沟壑、踏脚石和楼梯场景中实现可靠运动。此外，学习到的策略展现出涌现性的地形响应行为——在无需显式导航规划器的情况下，仅通过简单速度指令即可自主沿狭窄路径行进并规避障碍。在搭载机载激光雷达的Unitree G1仿人机器人实际部署中，所提方法在多种稀疏立足点与密集障碍环境中实现了鲁棒的零样本仿真到现实迁移。

title: PaCo-VLA: Passivity-Shielded Compliance Prior for Contact-Rich Vision-Language-Action Manipulation
summary: Contact-rich manipulation demands both high-level semantic reasoning and the safe regulation of high-frequency contact dynamics. While Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models provide unprecedented semantic generalization, their low-rate outputs lack the reliability required for direct plant authority in force-sensitive tasks. To bridge this semantic-to-control gap, we introduce PaCo-VLA, a passivity-shielded compliance prior that recasts the VLA interface. Rather than trusting VLAs with direct motor commands, PaCo-VLA treats network outputs as task-level compliance proposals: semantic bindings, task stages, and admittance schedules. A high-frequency, proposal-independent passivity shield governs these proposals through energy-tank accounting and boundary checks, preventing invalid, stale, or unverified model predictions from bypassing low-level contact physics. This decoupled architecture also enables causal evaluation, isolating semantic contributions from geometric shortcuts. Extensive simulated and real-world connector-insertion experiments demonstrate that PaCo-VLA achieves superior precision over unshielded VLA baselines, sustaining zero passivity violations even under adversarial compliance shifts. This framework establishes a provably sampled-passive runtime contract at the admittance port and provides a runtime interface for deploying foundation models in contact-rich domains.
tldr: PaCo-VLA introduces a passivity-shielded compliance prior that decouples VLA outputs into task-level proposals governed by a high-frequency energy-tank shield, preventing unsafe commands in contact-rich manipulation.
tldr_zh: PaCo-VLA 提出了一种被动性屏蔽的柔顺先验，将 VLA 输出解耦为任务级建议，并由高频率能量罐防护层管控，防止接触丰富操作中出现不安全指令。
summary_zh: 接触丰富的操作既需要高层语义推理，也需要对高频接触动力学进行安全调节。尽管视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型提供了前所未有的语义泛化能力，但其低频输出在力敏感任务中缺乏直接控制被控对象所需的可靠性。为弥合这一语义到控制的鸿沟，我们提出了PaCo-VLA——一种被动性保护的顺应性先验，重新定义了VLA接口。PaCo-VLA不将直接电机指令交由VLA处理，而是将网络输出视为任务级顺应性提议：包括语义绑定、任务阶段和导纳调度。一个独立于提议的高频被动性护盾通过能量罐核算和边界检查管理这些提议，防止无效、过时或未经校验的模型预测绕过底层接触物理规律。这种解耦架构还实现了因果评估，将语义贡献与几何捷径相分离。大量仿真和真实世界的连接器插拔实验表明，PaCo-VLA相比无防护的VLA基线实现了更高精度，即使在对抗性顺应性偏移下也能保持零被动性违反。该框架在导纳端口建立了可证明的采样被动运行时契约，并为在接触丰富领域部署基础模型提供了运行时接口。

title: Constrained Whole-Body Tracking for Humanoid Robots
summary: Recent advances in reinforcement learning (RL) have demonstrated impressive whole-body agility for humanoid robots, yet ensuring safety and satisfying constraints -- particularly those specified after training -- remains a challenge. Towards this goal, we present ConstrainedMimic, a control framework that leverages whole-body kinematics and dynamics for real-time constraint enforcement within RL tracking policies. By integrating principles from operational space control and control barrier functions (CBFs), we enable the satisfaction of arbitrary runtime constraints on both the kinematic reference motion and the underlying dynamics. In whole-body motion-tracking and teleoperation experiments on a (simulated) Unitree G1 with a learned policy, we demonstrate collision avoidance (both with the robot body and external obstacles), joint limits, and center of mass stability constraints. By remaining consistent with the current contact mode and tracking objectives, we minimally restrict the capabilities of the policy when constraints are active. Our method is fully differentiable, runs on CPU, GPU, and TPU, and can be deployed at up to 300-500 Hz. All software will be freely available upon publication.
tldr: A control framework combining operational space control and control barrier functions to enforce runtime safety constraints (collision, joint limits, stability) on RL-based whole-body tracking policies for humanoid robots.
tldr_zh: 一个结合操作空间控制与障碍函数的控制框架，用于在基于强化学习的全身跟踪策略上运行时强制执行安全约束（碰撞、关节极限、稳定性）。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
强化学习（RL）的最新进展已使仿人机器人展现出令人瞩目的全身敏捷能力，然而在确保安全性并满足约束条件（尤其是训练后指定的约束）方面仍面临挑战。为此，我们提出ConstrainedMimic控制框架，该框架利用全身运动学与动力学，在RL跟踪策略中实时执行约束。通过融合操作空间控制与控制障碍函数（CBF）的原理，我们能够在运动学参考运动及底层动力学上满足任意运行时约束。在基于学习策略的（仿真）Unitree G1全身运动跟踪与遥操作实验中，我们验证了碰撞规避（包括机器人自身与外部障碍物）、关节限位及质心稳定性约束的效果。通过保持与当前接触模式及跟踪目标的一致性，我们在约束激活时最小化了对策略能力的限制。该方法完全可微，支持在CPU、GPU及TPU上运行，部署频率可达300-500 Hz。所有软件将在论文发表后免费开源。

title: StressDream: Steering Video World Models for Robust Policy Evaluation and Improvement
summary: Video world models (WMs) have shown promise for policy evaluation and improvement by imagining realistic future observations conditioned on ego-robot actions. While WMs can model distributions over futures, policy evaluation and improvement typically rely on nominal imaginations, which can miss high-impact outcomes of robot actions unless prohibitively many samples are drawn. To enable robust policy evaluation and improvement over WM imaginations, we propose StressDream, which steers imaginations toward high-impact yet plausible outcomes specified at inference time by optimizing the initial noise of diffusion-based WMs. However, optimizing high-dimensional noise is challenging: the optimization must reason about nuanced, scene-dependent target events in generated videos while avoiding out-of-distribution (OOD) noise that yields implausible imaginations. We address this with two complementary objectives: a semantic objective with a Vision-Language Model that provides informative gradients by reasoning about the generated video, and a plausibility objective that prevents the optimized noise from drifting OOD. With state-of-the-art video world models for autonomous driving and robotic manipulation, we show that StressDream effectively steers imaginations toward high-impact yet plausible outcomes specified by text at inference time, such as task failures, enabling robust policy evaluation and improvement by identifying actions whose plausible futures include undesirable outcomes. Video results are available at https://junwon.me/StressDream/.
tldr: StressDream steers diffusion-based video world models toward high-impact, plausible outcomes (e.g., task failures) by optimizing initial noise with a VLM-based semantic objective and a plausibility constraint, enabling robust policy evaluation and improvement in autonomous driving and robotic manipulation.
tldr_zh: StressDream 通过优化扩散视频世界模型的初始噪声，结合 VLM 语义目标和合理性约束，引导模型生成高影响且合理的未来结果（如任务失败），从而在自动驾驶和机器人操作中实现鲁棒的策略评估与改进。
summary_zh: 视频世界模型（WMs）通过基于机器人自身动作想象逼真的未来观测，在策略评估与改进中展现出潜力。尽管世界模型能够对未来的分布进行建模，但策略评估与改进通常依赖于名义上的想象，这可能会遗漏机器人动作的高影响结果，除非抽取极其大量的样本。为实现对世界模型想象结果的鲁棒策略评估与改进，我们提出StressDream方法——通过在推理阶段优化扩散式世界模型的初始噪声，将想象引导至由文本指定的、高影响且合理的未来场景。然而，优化高维噪声颇具挑战：优化过程需在生成视频中推理细微且依赖场景的目标事件，同时避免因产生分布外（OOD）噪声而生成不合理的想象。我们通过两个互补目标解决此问题：一是基于视觉-语言模型的语义目标，通过推理生成视频提供信息量丰富的梯度；二是合理性目标，防止优化后的噪声偏离分布外。结合面向自动驾驶与机器人操作的最先进视频世界模型，我们证实StressDream能够有效将想象引导至推理阶段由文本指定的高影响且合理的场景（如任务失败），从而通过识别那些合理未来包含不良后果的动作，实现鲁棒的策略评估与改进。视频结果见https://junwon.me/StressDream/。

title: Per-Group Error, Not Total MSE: Fine-Tuning Vision-Language-Action Models for 11-DoF Mobile Manipulation
summary:
Fine-tuning Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for mobile manipulators with heterogeneous joint spaces can produce a counterintuitive result: the checkpoint with the lowest aggregate MSE is not the one that performs best on the real robot. We argue this is a predictable consequence of collapsing heterogeneous joint groups (arm, gripper, head, wheeled base) into a single metric, where easy-to-predict joints can mask joints that still fail.
  We fine-tune SmolVLA (450M, action-expert only) on the 11-DoF Toyota HSR and compare it against $π_{0.5}$ (3.3B), a stronger pretrained baseline. Per-group analysis exposes two patterns: in SmolVLA, the mobile base converges slowest and limits overall performance. In expert-only fine-tuning of $π_{0.5}$ (training only the action head, backbone frozen), total MSE drops below the baseline but arm accuracy degrades. On 60 real-robot trials (20 per model), $π_{0.5}$ 80k (4.0/4) significantly outperforms both fine-tuned variants (expert-only 3k: 3.75/4; HSR-SmolVLA: 3.5/4; Mann-Whitney $p \leq 0.010$), despite expert-only 3k having the lowest total MSE. This separation is most consistent with the offline arm-group error, not total MSE or base-group error. We conclude that per-group error is a more reliable signal than total MSE for checkpoint selection on robots with heterogeneous action spaces. Code: https://github.com/paumontagut/per-group-mse-vla
tldr: This paper shows that for fine-tuning VLA models on mobile manipulators with heterogeneous joint spaces, per-group error is a more reliable checkpoint selection signal than total MSE, and validates this on an 11-DoF real robot with SmolVLA and π0.5.
tldr_zh: 本文指出，对于具有异构关节空间的移动机械臂，微调VLA模型时，按组误差比总MSE更能可靠地选择检查点，并通过11自由度真实机器人上的SmolVLA和π0.5实验验证了这一结论。
summary_zh:
微调面向异构关节空间移动操作器的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型会产生一个反直觉的结果：聚合均方误差（MSE）最低的检查点，并非在真实机器人上表现最佳的模型。我们认为，这是由于将异构关节组（机械臂、夹爪、头部、轮式底盘）压缩至单一指标所产生的可预测后果——易于预测的关节会掩盖仍存在问题的关节。

我们在11自由度的丰田HSR机器人上微调了SmolVLA（450M参数，仅训练动作专家模块），并将其与更强的预训练基线模型$π_{0.5}$（3.3B参数）进行比较。逐组分析揭示了两种模式：在SmolVLA中，移动底盘收敛最慢，从而限制了整体性能。在对$π_{0.5}$进行仅专家模块微调（仅训练动作头，冻结骨干网络）时，总MSE低于基线，但机械臂精度下降。在60次真实机器人试验（每个模型20次）中，$π_{0.5}$ 80k（4.0/4）显著优于两个微调变体（仅专家模块3k：3.75/4；HSR-SmolVLA：3.5/4；曼-惠特尼检验$p \leq 0.010$），尽管仅专家模块3k的总MSE最低。这种分化与离线机械臂组误差最为一致，而非总MSE或底盘组误差。我们得出结论：对于具有异构动作空间的机器人，在检查点选择时，逐组误差比总MSE是更可靠的信号。代码：https://github.com/paumontagut/per-group-mse-vla

title: HOIST: Humanoid Optimization with Imitation and Sample-efficient Tuning for Manipulating Suspended Loads
summary: Manipulating suspended payloads with humanoid robots is challenging because the robot can only influence an underactuated, oscillatory load through whole-body motion and intermittent contact. Imitation learning provides safe initial behavior but does not directly optimize final placement, while reinforcement learning from scratch is unsafe and sample-inefficient on real humanoids. We present HOIST-Humanoid Optimized with Imitation and Sample-efficient Tuning for manipulating suspended loads. HOIST first finetunes a high-level vision-language-action (VLA) policy from virtual-reality (VR) teleoperation demonstrations and executes its commands through a whole-body controller. It then uses VLA rollouts and iterative batched RL to improve placement accuracy and stopping behavior. Experiments in simulation and on a real humanoid show that HOIST improves over imitation-only and additional-demonstration baselines; compared with pure VLA rollouts, HOIST reduces translational placement error by 19.9 cm and raw angular error by 3.56 degrees, demonstrating the potential of humanoids for underactuated material-handling tasks.
tldr: HOIST fine-tunes a VLA policy from VR teleoperation demonstrations and uses iterative batched RL to improve placement accuracy for humanoid robots manipulating suspended loads, reducing translational error by 19.9 cm on a real humanoid.
tldr_zh: HOIST 通过从 VR 遥操作演示中微调视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略，再结合迭代批量强化学习，提高了人形机器人操作悬挂负载的放置精度，在实际人形机器人上平移误差减少了 19.9 厘米。
summary_zh: 操控类人机器人处理悬挂负载具有挑战性，原因在于机器人只能通过全身运动与间歇性接触来影响一个欠驱动的振荡负载。模仿学习能提供安全的初始行为，但无法直接优化最终放置位置；而从头开始的强化学习在实际类人机器人上既不安全，样本效率也低。我们提出HOIST（基于模仿与样本高效调优的类人机器人悬挂负载优化方法），用于操控悬挂负载。HOIST首先通过虚拟现实（VR）遥操作演示对高层视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略进行微调，并通过全身控制器执行其指令；随后利用VLA轨迹展开与迭代批量强化学习来提高放置精度与停止行为。仿真实验与实际类人机器人实验表明，HOIST相较于仅使用模仿学习与额外演示的基线方法均有提升；与纯VLA轨迹展开相比，HOIST将平移放置误差降低19.9厘米，原始角度误差降低3.56度，展现了类人机器人在欠驱动物料搬运任务中的潜力。

title: Continuous Reasoning for Vision-Language-Action
summary:
Natural language is a powerful reasoning medium for language and vision-language models, but it is mismatched to the granularity of continuous control. Text and explicit subgoals operate at task-level granularity, whereas vision-language-action (VLA) policies must choose actions at a much finer temporal scale; a single reasoning step can therefore span many action chunks while remaining only weakly coupled to the action needed now. This suggests a different question for VLA: what should play the role of language? We argue that a useful VLA reasoning medium must be shareable across model instances, verifiable through downstream action improvement, and aligned with temporally extended control structure.
  Based on this view, we propose Continuous Reasoning for Vision-Language-Action. Our model first predicts continuous reasoning in the form of a structured set of continuous thoughts, then reuses them as shared context for chunk-structured action generation. Better action prediction alone does not certify good reasoning: if the same internal medium cannot be shared across model instances and independently verified through improved downstream control, the added latent may simply become a model-private shortcut that helps on seen behaviors without supporting generalizable control. We therefore instantiate continuous reasoning as a shared Gaussian latent interface and train it with a self-verification objective in which an exponential-moving-average teacher must successfully consume the student's reasoning when predicting target actions.
  Empirically, Continuous Reasoning improves LIBERO-PRO robustness and performs strongly on real robots, raising mean subtask success over π0.5 by 40.4% on TX-G2, an AgiBot G2-compatible variant, and 26.3% on HSR. This suggests that reasoning in VLA is less about extra tokens than about a shareable, verifiable internal language for action.
tldr: This paper proposes a continuous reasoning interface of Gaussian latents with a self-verification objective for VLA models, improving robustness and real-robot success rates over π0.5.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于高斯潜变量的连续推理接口及自验证目标，用于视觉-语言-动作模型，在真实机器人上提升了鲁棒性和任务成功率。
summary_zh:
自然语言是语言模型和视觉-语言模型的强大推理媒介，但与连续控制的精细粒度不匹配。文本与显式子目标在任务级粒度上运作，而视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略必须在更精细的时间尺度上选择动作；因此，单个推理步骤可能跨越多个动作块，同时与当前所需的动作仅有弱耦合。这为VLA提出了一个不同的问题：语言应该扮演什么角色？我们认为，一个有用的VLA推理媒介必须能在不同模型实例间共享、可通过下游动作改进进行验证，并与时间扩展的控制结构对齐。

基于这一观点，我们提出视觉-语言-动作连续推理方法。我们的模型首先以结构化连续思维集合的形式预测连续推理，随后将其作为共享上下文用于块结构动作生成。仅凭更好的动作预测并不能保证良好的推理：如果相同的内部媒介无法跨模型实例共享，且无法通过改进的下游控制独立验证，那么添加的潜在变量可能仅仅成为模型私有的捷径，有助于处理已见行为却无法支持可泛化的控制。为此，我们将连续推理实例化为共享高斯潜变量接口，并采用自验证目标进行训练：指数移动平均教师模型在预测目标动作时必须成功消费学生的推理结果。

实验表明，连续推理提升了LIBERO-PRO的鲁棒性，并在真实机器人上表现强劲：在兼容AgiBot G2的变体TX-G2上，相较于π0.5，平均子任务成功率提升40.4%；在HSR上提升26.3%。这表明VLA中的推理与其说是额外标记，不如说是一种可共享、可验证的用于动作的内部语言。

title: From Noise to Control: Parameterized Diffusion Policies
summary: We propose Parameterized Diffusion Policy (PDP), a framework for learning diffusion policies conditioned on low-dimensional, continuous parameters embedded in a learned behavior manifold. By constructing this manifold so that distances between latent representations reflect the semantic similarity between physical trajectories, we transform diffusion from a mechanism for stochastic diversity into a precise and optimizable tool for behavior steering. Our approach enables smooth interpolation between known strategies and efficient adaptation to novel constraints without updating policy weights. We demonstrate that PDP significantly improves adaptation performance on complex multimodal benchmarks in both simulated and real-robot experiments compared to standard diffusion policies, particularly in scenarios requiring the synthesis of novel behaviors.
tldr: PDP introduces a parameterized diffusion policy that learns a behavior manifold for smooth interpolation and adaptation to novel constraints without weight updates, improving performance on robot manipulation benchmarks.
tldr_zh: PDP 提出参数化扩散策略，通过学习行为流形实现平滑插值和新约束适应，无需更新权重，在机器人操作基准上提升性能。
summary_zh: 我们提出了参数化扩散策略（PDP），这是一个学习扩散策略的框架，该策略以嵌入在所学行为流形中的低维连续参数为条件。通过构建此流形，使得潜在表示之间的距离能够反映物理轨迹之间的语义相似性，我们将扩散从一种随机多样性的机制转变为一种用于行为引导的精确且可优化的工具。我们的方法能够在已知策略之间实现平滑插值，并在无需更新策略权重的情况下高效适应新的约束条件。我们证明，与标准扩散策略相比，PDP在模拟和真实机器人实验中的复杂多模态基准测试中显著提升了适应性能，尤其是在需要合成新行为的场景中。

title: Closed-Loop Neural Activation Control in Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models can be steered at test time by intervening on semantically meaningful internal directions, but existing methods use a fixed steering coefficient, effectively operating in open loop. This is poorly suited to embodied control, where task state and concept error evolve over time, often causing overcorrection, oscillation, and reduced task success, especially for temporal behaviors such as speed and smoothness. We propose CTRL-STEER, a closed-loop framework that replaces static intervention strength with adaptive, time-varying control signals. The key idea is to decouple representation from regulation: rather than assuming temporal concepts are directly controlled by individual neurons, we steer along motion-aligned residual directions while a feedback controller adjusts intervention magnitude online. We instantiate this framework with both PID and reinforcement learning based controllers. Experiments with a fine-tuned OpenVLA policy on four LIBERO task suites show that CTRL-STEER achieves more stable concept regulation and a better steering-task success trade-off than fixed-coefficient baselines, without modifying or retraining the base model.
tldr: This paper introduces CTRL-STEER, a closed-loop framework that adaptively adjusts steering strength in VLA models using feedback control (PID/RL), enabling more stable concept regulation and better task success on real robot manipulation benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出CTRL-STEER，一种在VLA模型中通过反馈控制（PID/RL）自适应调整干预强度的闭环框架，在真实机器人操作基准上实现更稳定的概念调控和更好的任务成功率。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过在测试时对语义相关的内部方向进行干预来实现引导控制，但现有方法使用固定的引导系数，本质上是开环操作。这种方式难以适应具身控制任务——其中任务状态和概念误差随时间动态演化，常常导致过度校正、振荡以及任务成功率下降，尤其对于速度和平滑度等时序行为。我们提出CTRL-STEER，一种用自适应、时变控制信号替代静态干预强度的闭环框架。其核心思想是将表征与调节解耦：不再假设时序概念由单个神经元直接控制，而是沿运动对齐的残差方向进行引导，同时通过反馈控制器在线调整干预幅度。我们基于PID和强化学习两种控制器实现了该框架。在四个LIBERO任务套件上对微调后的OpenVLA策略进行实验表明，CTRL-STEER相比固定系数的基线方法实现了更稳定的概念调节与更好的引导-任务成功率权衡，且无需修改或重新训练基础模型。

title: MBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark on Memory Capability for Video World Models
summary: Recent advancements in video-based world models have demonstrated an unprecedented ability to synthesize high-fidelity visual sequences. However, a fundamental gap persists between visually plausible video generation and the functional requirements of a world model, particularly in maintaining a stable and reasonable internal state over extended temporal horizons. While existing benchmarks primarily emphasize visual quality, motion coherence, and text-video alignment, they largely overlook memory, the core capability of a world model to preserve consistency across long-term horizons and complex interactions. To address this gap, we present \textbf{MBench}, a comprehensive benchmark dedicated to quantifying and evaluating the memory capability of video world models. We systematically decompose the memory capability of video world models into three hierarchical and complementary core dimensions: entity consistency, environment consistency, and causal consistency, which are further refined into 12 quantifiable sub-dimensions for comprehensive characterization of long-term memory. Our benchmark is built upon rigorously curated real-captured long videos, and evaluated by rule-based quantitative matrices and VLM to enable objective and comprehensive consistency assessment. Extensive evaluations of mainstream state-of-the-art video world models reveal critical systemic limitations of existing methods in long-term state retention, providing a standardized benchmark and clear research direction to advance the field.
tldr: MBench is a benchmark for evaluating the long-term memory capability of video world models, deconstructing memory into entity, environment, and causal consistency.
tldr_zh: MBench是一个用于评估视频世界模型长期记忆能力的基准测试，将记忆分解为实体一致性、环境一致性和因果一致性。
summary_zh: 近期，基于视频的世界模型取得了前所未有的进展，能够合成高保真度的视觉序列。然而，在视觉上合理的视频生成与世界模型的功能需求之间，始终存在一个根本性差距，尤其是在长时间跨度内维持稳定且合理的内部状态方面。现有基准测试主要强调视觉质量、运动连贯性以及文本-视频对齐，却基本忽视了记忆这一世界模型在长时间跨度与复杂交互中保持一致性的核心能力。为弥合这一空白，我们提出了 \textbf{MBench}，这是一个专门用于量化和评估视频世界模型记忆能力的综合性基准。我们系统地将视频世界模型的记忆能力分解为三个层次化且互补的核心维度：实体一致性、环境一致性和因果一致性，并进一步细化为 12 个可量化的子维度，以全面表征长期记忆。该基准基于经过严格筛选的真实长视频构建，并通过基于规则的量化矩阵与视觉语言模型进行评估，从而实现客观且全面的一致性评估。对主流先进视频世界模型的广泛评估揭示了现有方法在长期状态保持方面的关键系统性局限，为领域发展提供了标准化基准与清晰的研究方向。

title: Physical Object Understanding with a Physically Controllable World Model
summary: A central challenge in visual intelligence is learning the physical structure of scenes from raw videos: how regions form objects and the laws that govern their interactions. Solving these tasks requires world models capable of inferring distributional states of the world from partial observations - capabilities that current architectures do not provide. We introduce a new class of probabilistic world models that support estimation of the probability of any visual variable, such as appearance and dynamics, conditioned on any other variables. Here, we identify that these models can be trained efficiently with autoregressive sequence modeling, yielding world models from which rich object understanding emerges. First, we demonstrate that our model captures the physical laws governing how objects move by generating multiple plausible future states of the world through sequential inference. Then, by analyzing motion correlations across these futures, we extract objects and articulated object subparts. Having discovered these objects, we show that our world model can manipulate them in 3D. Finally, we demonstrate how physical relationships between objects can be computed from the world model, enabling applications such as Visual Jenga.
tldr: This paper proposes a probabilistic world model trained via autoregressive sequence modeling that learns physical object understanding, including dynamics, object segmentation, 3D manipulation, and physical relationship reasoning from video.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种通过自回归序列建模训练的随机世界模型，能够从视频中学习物理物体理解，包括动力学、物体分割、3D操控和物体间物理关系推理。
summary_zh: 在视觉智能领域中，一个核心挑战在于从原始视频中学习场景的物理结构：即区域如何形成物体，以及支配其相互作用的规律。解决这些任务需要能够从局部观测推断世界分布状态的世界模型——而现有架构并不具备这种能力。我们提出了一类新型概率世界模型，能够支持基于任意其他变量来估计任何视觉变量（如外观与动态）的概率。在此我们发现，这类模型可通过自回归序列建模实现高效训练，从而衍生出具备丰富物体理解能力的世界模型。首先，我们通过序列推理生成多个可能的未来世界状态，证明模型能够捕捉物体运动的物理规律。其次，通过分析这些未来状态中的运动相关性，我们提取出物体及其可动子部件。在发现这些物体后，我们展示了世界模型在三维空间中对它们进行操控的能力。最终，我们演示了如何从世界模型中计算物体间的物理关系，从而支持诸如视觉叠叠乐等应用。

title: 4D Radar Meets LiDAR and Camera: Cooperative Perception under Adverse Weather
summary: Cooperative perception is important for autonomous driving but remains fragile when cameras and LiDAR degrade in adverse weather. We address this challenge by integrating 4D imaging radar as a weather-robust modality into collaborative perception and introducing a Doppler-guided spatial attention mechanism for multi-agent fusion. Our approach extends two representative backbones: a radar-camera pipeline where radar substitutes LiDAR, and a LiDAR-radar pipeline where radar complements LiDAR. To support evaluation, we release radar-augmented benchmarks, OPV2V-R and Adver-City-R, with physics-based LiDAR degradation. Experiments show strong robustness gains in fog and rain, including substantial improvements when radar replaces degraded LiDAR. Additional validation on MAN TruckScenes demonstrates transfer beyond simulation. Overall, our results highlight 4D imaging radar as a robust modality for all-weather collaborative perception. Dataset and code are available at: https://url.fzi.de/SlimComm.
tldr: This paper integrates 4D imaging radar as a weather-robust modality for cooperative perception in autonomous driving, introduces Doppler-guided spatial attention for multi-agent fusion, and releases augmented benchmarks to demonstrate robustness gains under fog and rain.
tldr_zh: 本文将4D成像雷达作为恶劣天气下的鲁棒模态集成到自动驾驶协同感知中，提出多普勒引导空间注意力机制用于多智能体融合，并发布增强基准以展示在雾和雨下的鲁棒性提升。
summary_zh: 协同感知对自动驾驶至关重要，但在恶劣天气条件下摄像头与激光雷达性能下降时，其可靠性面临挑战。为解决该问题，我们将4D成像雷达作为具备天气鲁棒性的模态集成至协作感知中，并引入多智能体融合的多普勒引导空间注意力机制。该方法扩展了两种代表性基础架构：雷达-摄像头流水线（以雷达替代激光雷达）及激光雷达-雷达流水线（以雷达补充激光雷达）。为支持评估，我们发布了增强雷达数据的基准数据集OPV2V-R与Adver-City-R，其中包含基于物理模型的激光雷达退化模拟。实验表明，该方法在雾天与雨天场景中具有显著鲁棒性提升——当雷达替代性能退化的激光雷达时尤其明显。在MAN TruckScenes数据集上的额外验证进一步证实了其超越仿真环境的可迁移性。总体而言，我们的研究结果凸显了4D成像雷达作为全天候协同感知鲁棒模态的潜力。数据集与代码已开源：https://url.fzi.de/SlimComm

title: STEM: Semantic Target Search and Exploration using MAVs in Cluttered Environments
summary: Autonomous target search is crucial for deploying Micro Aerial Vehicles (MAVs) in emergency response and rescue missions. Existing approaches either focus on 2D semantic navigation in structured environments -- which is less effective in complex 3D settings, or on robotic exploration in cluttered spaces -- which often lacks the semantic reasoning needed for efficient target search. This paper overcomes these limitations by proposing a novel framework that utilizes a semantically-guided viewpoint planner to minimize target search and exploration time in unstructured 3D environments using an MAV. Specifically, we develop a combinatorial planner that generates efficient semantic exploration plans by prioritizing viewpoints that likely lead to the target. To guide the planner towards the target, an active perception pipeline is developed that propagates semantic priorities of observed objects into neighboring frontier voxels for computing semantic information gains of frontier viewpoints. In addition, we demonstrate how LLM-based similarity scores can be leveraged as semantic priority input to our pipeline. Evaluations in two distinct simulation environments show that the proposed method consistently outperforms baselines by quickly finding the target while maintaining reasonable exploration times. Real-world experiments with an MAV further demonstrate the method's ability to handle practical constraints like limited battery life, small sensor range, and semantic uncertainty.
tldr: This paper presents a semantically-guided viewpoint planning framework for MAVs to efficiently search for semantic targets in cluttered 3D environments, integrating LLM-based semantic priors and an active perception pipeline.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种语义引导的视点规划框架，使微型飞行器能够在杂乱的3D环境中高效搜索语义目标，集成了基于大语言模型的语义先验和主动感知流水线。
summary_zh: 自主目标搜索对于微型飞行器（MAV）在应急响应与救援任务中的应用至关重要。现有方法要么专注于结构化环境中的二维语义导航（在复杂三维场景中效果欠佳），要么侧重于杂乱空间中的机器人探索（往往缺乏高效目标搜索所需的语义推理能力）。本文提出一种新型框架，通过利用语义引导的视点规划器，使MAV在非结构化三维环境中最小化目标搜索与探索时间。具体而言，我们开发了一种组合规划器，通过优先选择可能导向目标的视点，生成高效的语义探索路径。为引导规划器向目标靠近，我们构建了主动感知管线，将观测物体的语义优先级传播至相邻边界体素，以计算边界视点的语义信息增益。此外，我们展示了如何将基于大语言模型（LLM）的相似度分数作为语义优先级输入集成至该管线。在两个不同仿真环境中的评估表明，所提方法在保持合理探索时间的同时，能通过快速定位目标持续优于基线方法。基于MAV的真实世界实验进一步验证了该方法应对实际约束（如有限电池续航、小型传感器范围及语义不确定性）的能力。

title: Beyond Pure Sampling: Hybrid Optimization Mechanisms for Non-Convex Model Predictive Control
summary:
This paper investigates the optimization mechanisms of non-convex Model Predictive Control (MPC) using the Maximum Entropy Differential Dynamic Programming (ME-DDP) framework. Navigating non-convex cost landscapes induced by nonlinear dynamics, multiple obstacles, etc. remains a fundamental challenge in robotics, where gradient-based methods frequently converge to suboptimal local minima. We demonstrate a dual-step optimization mechanism designed to overcome these traps. (1) an initial phase of using DDP to exploit the gradient of the cost landscape, followed by (2) disruption of the optimization via sampling from policies characterized by the inverse Hessian of the action-value function. We provide a rigorous analysis of this sampling mechanism of three ME-DDP variants: Unimodal Gaussian ME-DDP, Multimodal Gaussian ME-DDP, and Stein Variational DDP. Furthermore, with navigation tasks of four robotic systems under cluttered environments, we conduct extensive benchmarking of three variants of the ME-DDP, against deterministic DDP, and one of the most successful sampling-based schemes, Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) control with three policy parameterizations and update laws that correspond to those of ME-DDPs.
  The results show that in low-dimensional systems where the cost landscapes are relatively simple and local information is sufficiently representative, our framework consistently outperforms MPPIs. In high-dimensional systems, MPPI can occasionally discover aggressive maneuvers that enable it to steer the systems faster than DDP-based methods, whereas our method maintains a higher, more stable success rate.
  Finally, we validate the practical efficacy of the framework through hardware experiments with a quadrotor navigating a dense, non-convex obstacle field, confirming the robustness of the proposed framework for real-world deployment.
tldr: This paper introduces a hybrid optimization framework combining gradient-based DDP with sampling-based methods (ME-DDP variants) to escape local minima in non-convex MPC for robotic motion planning, validated on simulated and real quadrotor navigation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种混合优化框架，将基于梯度的DDP与采样方法（ME-DDP变体）结合，以逃离非凸MPC中的局部极小值，并在仿真和真实四旋翼导航中验证。
summary_zh:
本文研究了基于最大熵微分动态规划（ME-DDP）框架的非凸模型预测控制（MPC）的优化机制。在机器人技术中，由非线性动力学、多障碍物等引发的非凸代价地形始终是核心挑战，基于梯度的方法常收敛于次优局部极小值。我们提出了一种用于突破这些陷阱的双步优化机制：（1）初始阶段利用DDP挖掘代价地形的梯度信息；（2）随后通过对由动作价值函数的逆海森矩阵所表征策略进行采样，破坏原有优化过程。我们严格分析了三种ME-DDP变体（单峰高斯ME-DDP、多峰高斯ME-DDP和斯坦变分DDP）的采样机制。此外，针对四种机器人系统在杂乱环境中的导航任务，我们将三种ME-DDP变体与确定性DDP，以及最成功的基于采样的方案之一——采用与ME-DDP对应三种策略参数化及更新律的模型预测路径积分（MPPI）控制——进行了广泛基准测试。

结果表明：在代价地形相对简单、局部信息具有充分代表性的低维系统中，我们的框架始终优于MPPI方法；而在高维系统中，MPPI虽偶尔能通过激进机动策略实现比基于DDP方法更快的系统引导，但我们的方法保持了更高且更稳定的成功率。最后，我们通过四旋翼飞行器在密集非凸障碍场中的硬件实验验证了该框架的实际效果，确认了所提方法在实际部署中的鲁棒性。

title: Shape Your Body: Value Gradients for Multi-Embodiment Robot Design
summary: We propose to turn generalist multi-embodiment value functions into reusable models for robot design. Instead of running a new reinforcement learning co-design loop for each robot, we first train an embodiment-aware policy and value function across many robot designs. After training, the frozen value function is used as a differentiable surrogate to optimize candidate embodiments through value gradients. We evaluate our approach across different robot design settings, from perturbed single robots to held-out robots across morphology classes, with single models trained on up to 50 robots and design spaces of over 1100 continuous embodiment parameters. Beyond optimizing complete embodiments, we show that value gradients can identify performance-limiting design and control parameters, enabling both the optimization and the analysis of new robot designs.
tldr: Proposes using frozen, embodiment-aware value functions as differentiable surrogates to optimize robot designs via value gradients, enabling co-design without retraining.
tldr_zh: 提出利用冻结的、具身感知的值函数作为可微替代品，通过值梯度优化机器人设计，无需重新训练即可实现协同设计。
summary_zh: 我们提出将通用多实体价值函数转化为可复用的机器人设计模型。与为每个机器人启动新的强化学习协同设计循环不同，我们首先在多种机器人设计上训练具有实体感知能力的策略与价值函数。训练完成后，冻结的价值函数被用作可微分代理，通过价值梯度优化候选实体。我们评估了该方法在不同机器人设计场景中的表现，涵盖从受扰动的单一机器人到跨形态类别的未见过机器人，所训练的单一模型覆盖多达50种机器人及超过1100个连续实体参数的设计空间。除优化完整实体外，我们证明价值梯度能够识别限制性能的设计与控制参数，从而实现对新型机器人设计的优化与分析。

title: Dynamic Resilient Spatio-Semantic Memory with Hybrid Localization for Mobile Manipulation
summary: Reliable mobile manipulation in dynamic indoor environments requires a scene representation that remains geometrically consistent, semantically queryable, and computationally bounded as the environment changes. Existing systems often rely on pre-built maps, static-scene assumptions, or highly accurate camera poses, which can lead to stale or misaligned scene information when target objects are relocated or pose estimates are corrected. This paper presents DREAM, a real-robot mobile manipulation framework that integrates perception, memory, localization, navigation, and manipulation in previously unseen indoor environments without a pre-built map. DREAM constructs an online spatio-semantic voxel memory from RGB-D observations registered by a LiDAR-inertial-visual SLAM backend. It further introduces pose-graph-aware Redundancy-Aware Memory Pruning (RMP) to update historical observations after pose corrections while keeping long-horizon observation history bounded. For target localization and reacquisition, DREAM combines language-conditioned 3D retrieval, open-vocabulary image detection, and multimodal large language model based semantic verification. Real-robot experiments in four dynamic indoor laboratory scenes show that DREAM improves long-horizon task success rates from 40%-60% with DynaMem to 55%-70%, while maintaining a memory footprint of 0.37-0.63 GB and an online memory-update time of 0.43-0.53 s across scenes.
tldr: DREAM is a real-robot mobile manipulation framework that builds an online, resilient spatio-semantic voxel memory from RGB-D data with a LiDAR-inertial-visual SLAM backend, enabling long-horizon tasks in dynamic environments without pre-built maps.
tldr_zh: DREAM是一个真实机器人移动操作框架，通过LiDAR-惯性-视觉SLAM后端从RGB-D数据在线构建弹性时空语义体素记忆，无需预建地图即可在动态环境中完成长时任务。
summary_zh: 在动态室内环境中实现可靠的移动操作，需要一种场景表征方式，该表征能在环境变化时保持几何一致性、支持语义查询，并将计算资源消耗控制在合理范围内。现有系统通常依赖预建地图、静态场景假设或高精度相机位姿，当目标物体发生移动或位姿估计结果被修正时，往往导致场景信息过时或错位。本文提出DREAM——一种面向真实机器人的移动操作框架，它无需预建地图即可在未见过的室内环境中整合感知、记忆、定位、导航与操作能力。DREAM通过激光雷达-惯性-视觉SLAM后端配准的RGB-D观测数据，在线构建空间-语义体素记忆。该框架进一步引入基于位姿图感知的冗余感知记忆修剪（RMP），在维持长时域观测历史有限增长的同时，实现位姿修正后历史观测数据的更新。针对目标定位与重新获取，DREAM融合了语言条件约束的三维检索、开放词汇图像检测以及基于多模态大语言模型的语义验证。在四个动态室内实验室场景的真实机器人实验中，DREAM将长时域任务成功率从DynaMem的40%-60%提升至55%-70%，同时将各场景的记忆占用控制在0.37-0.63 GB范围内，在线记忆更新时间保持在0.43-0.53秒。

title: PACE: Phase-Aware Chunk Execution for Robot Policies with Action Chunking
summary: Recent vision-language-action and diffusion-based robot policies often use action chunking, where each policy query predicts a sequence of future actions and the robot executes an open-loop prefix before re-querying. While this interface improves local motion continuity, deployment still requires choosing the execution horizon: how much of each predicted chunk should be executed before acquiring a new observation. However, our experiments show that success is strongly task-dependent and non-monotonic with respect to the execution horizon, making a single constant horizon an unreliable deployment rule. We propose PACE (Phase-Aware Chunk Execution), a training-free test-time execution method that selects the execution horizon online from the predicted chunk itself. PACE exploits the phase-dependent kinematic structure of manipulation trajectories by identifying low-speed transition points in the predicted speed profile and using them as candidate replanning boundaries. Because PACE uses only the predicted action chunk, it is plug-and-play and requires no retraining or access to policy internals. We validate PACE through large-scale evaluations in both simulation and real-robot settings. On 50 RoboTwin2.0 tasks, PACE raises the average success rate from 57.8% to 64.2%. In real-robot experiments on bimanual ALOHA and single-arm Franka platforms, PACE improves the average task score from 60.7 to 77.7 and the average success rate from 50.7% to 70.4%. Ablations and rollout-level analyses show that PACE adapts execution horizons across manipulation phases, shortening near transitions while preserving longer execution during coherent motion.
tldr: PACE proposes a training-free, test-time method that adaptively selects the execution horizon for action-chunked robot policies by identifying low-speed transition points in the predicted action chunk, improving success rates on simulated and real manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: PACE 提出了一种无需训练、测试时自适应选择动作块执行水平的方法，通过识别预测动作块中的低速过渡点来调整重规划时机，在仿真和真实操作任务中提升了成功率。
summary_zh: 近期基于视觉-语言-动作和扩散的机器人策略通常采用动作分块（action chunking）方式，即每次策略查询预测一系列未来动作，机器人执行开环前缀后再重新查询。虽然这种接口改善了局部运动连续性，但部署时仍需选择执行视界（execution horizon）：在获取新观测数据前应执行每个预测分块中多长的动作序列。然而，我们的实验表明，成功率高度依赖于具体任务，且与执行视界呈非单调关系，这使得固定单一视界无法作为可靠的部署规则。为此，我们提出PACE（阶段感知分块执行，Phase-Aware Chunk Execution），这是一种无需训练、仅需测试时执行的方法，能够从预测分块本身在线选择执行视界。PACE通过识别预测速度曲线中的低速过渡点，将其作为候选重规划边界，从而利用操作轨迹中与阶段相关的运动学结构。由于PACE仅依赖预测的动作分块，因此具有即插即用特性，无需重新训练或访问策略内部信息。我们通过仿真与真实机器人环境中的大规模实验验证了PACE的有效性。在50个RoboTwin2.0任务中，PACE将平均成功率从57.8%提升至64.2%；在双臂ALOHA与单臂Franka平台的真实机器人实验中，PACE将平均任务得分从60.7提升至77.7，平均成功率从50.7%提升至70.4%。消融实验与轨迹级分析表明，PACE能根据不同操作阶段自适应调整执行视界：在过渡阶段缩短执行长度，同时在连贯运动阶段保持较长的执行周期。

title: A passive universal grasping mechanism based on an everting shell
summary: A passive monolithic compliant grasping mechanism that works based on the eversion of an elastically deformable bistable shell is conceptualized. It comprises grasping arms made of beam segments that work in conjunction with the everting shell. The grasper is capable of picking up a stiff object of any shape up to a maximum size and weight. The bistable shell everts upon contact with the object to enable the grasping arms envelop the object forming an enclosure. The mechanism then stays in that configuration until it is actuated again to turn the shell back to its original configuration and thereby opening the enclosure to release the object. The stiffness of the arms decides the payload of the mechanism. The size of the arms decides the largest object that can be grasped and held. The arms have distributed compliance so that they can conform to the shape of the object without applying undue force on it.
tldr: This paper introduces a passive, monolithic grasping mechanism that uses an everting bistable shell to envelop and hold objects of arbitrary shape without active control or sensing.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种基于双稳态翻转壳体的被动式整体抓取机构，能够在不需主动控制或感知的情况下包络并抓取任意形状的物体。
summary_zh: 一种基于弹性可变形双稳态壳体外翻工作的被动式单片柔性抓取机构被提出。该机构包含由梁段构成的抓取臂，这些抓取臂与外翻壳体协同工作。该抓取器能够拾取任意形状、最大尺寸和重量范围内的刚性物体。双稳态壳体在与物体接触时发生外翻，使抓取臂包裹物体形成封闭空间。随后机构保持该构型，直至再次被驱动使壳体恢复原始构型，从而打开封闭空间释放物体。抓取臂的刚度决定了机构的承载能力，其尺寸则决定了可抓取并保持的最大物体尺寸。抓取臂具有分布柔性，可自适应贴合物体形状而无需施加过大作用力。

title: ROG-Grasp: Root-Oriented Geometry for Robotic Grasping and Placement
summary: Orientation-aware manipulation is essential in post-harvest agricultural processing, where produce must be grasped and placed in consistent configurations. This paper presents ROG-Grasp, a geometry-based robotic grasping and placement framework that estimates the produce orientation from root surface geometry using RGB-D perception. A YOLO-based root detector and point cloud plane fitting are used to infer the root normal, enabling stable grasp pose generation and orientation-constrained Cartesian motion planning. Experiments on tomatoes and onions demonstrate high success rates and stable execution time in both isolated and cluttered scenarios. Compared with vision-language-action (VLA) policies, the proposed method achieves more reliable and accurate grasp completion with faster execution. These results highlight the effectiveness of geometry-driven perception for practical orientation-controlled manipulation tasks. A video of our paper is available online https://youtu.be/Ir2UtGODdMo.
tldr: ROG-Grasp uses root surface geometry and RGB-D perception to achieve orientation-aware grasping and placement for agricultural produce, outperforming VLA policies in reliability and speed.
tldr_zh: ROG-Grasp利用根部表面几何和RGB-D感知实现农产品姿態感知抓取与放置，在可靠性和速度上优于VLA策略。
summary_zh: 面向朝向的操控在产后农业加工中至关重要，因为农产品必须以一致的姿态被抓取和放置。本文提出ROG-Grasp，一种基于几何的机器人抓取与放置框架，通过RGB-D感知从根茎表面几何推断农产品朝向。采用基于YOLO的根茎检测器与点云平面拟合来推断根茎法向，进而实现稳定的抓取姿态生成以及受朝向约束的笛卡尔运动规划。在番茄和洋葱上的实验表明，该方法在孤立与杂乱场景中均具有高成功率和稳定的执行时间。与视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略相比，所提方法实现了更可靠、更精确的抓取完成，且执行速度更快。这些结果凸显了几何驱动感知在实用化朝向控制操控任务中的有效性。本文相关视频可在https://youtu.be/Ir2UtGODdMo在线观看。

title: DRL-Based Pose Control for Double-Ackermann Robots Under Actuation Uncertainties
summary: Robust deployment of deep reinforcement learning (DRL) policies on real robots remains challenging due to discrepancies between simulation and real-world dynamics. We address this issue in the context of maneuvering with double-Ackermann-steering mobile robots, which introduce additional constraints due to their non-holonomic nature. Building upon the DRL framework ManeuverNet, we extend its objective from position control to full pose control, resulting in a more challenging task. We further investigate the impact of actuation-related uncertainties on policy transfer. The use of simplified actuation models during training of the extended policy can lead to poor generalization, shown by a success rate drop from 100% in PyBullet to 25% in Gazebo under stricter evaluation conditions. To address this limitation, we adopt a sim-to-sim-to-real approach, where actuation effects observed in Gazebo are incorporated into the PyBullet training environment. Using multi-environment DRL with SAC and CrossQ, we learn policies that remain robust despite modeling inaccuracies. This approach can significantly reduce the performance gap across simulators, achieving up to 92% success rate in Gazebo and maintaining 69% under stricter thresholds, with successful transfer to a real robot without additional tuning.
tldr: This paper extends a DRL-based navigation framework to full pose control for double-Ackermann mobile robots and proposes a sim-to-sim-to-real approach to mitigate actuation uncertainties, achieving improved transfer success rates in simulation and on a real robot.
tldr_zh: 本文针对双阿克曼移动机器人，将基于深度强化学习的导航框架扩展到完整位姿控制，并提出一种仿真到仿真再到实物的方法，以缓解执行器不确定性，在仿真和实物机器人上均实现了更高的迁移成功率。
summary_zh: 在真实机器人上稳健部署深度强化学习策略仍具挑战性，这源于仿真环境与现实动力学之间的差异。我们在双阿克曼转向移动机器人操纵场景中解决此问题——这类机器人因非完整约束特性而引入额外限制。基于深度强化学习框架ManeuverNet，我们将其目标从位置控制扩展至全位姿控制，从而形成更具挑战性的任务。我们进一步研究了驱动相关不确定性对策略迁移的影响。在扩展策略训练过程中使用简化驱动模型会导致泛化能力不足，具体表现为在更严格评估条件下，成功率从PyBullet中的100%骤降至Gazebo中的25%。为解决这一局限，我们采用“仿真-到-仿真-到-真实”方法，将Gazebo中观测到的驱动效应融入PyBullet训练环境。通过结合SAC与CrossQ的多环境深度强化学习，我们训练出的策略即使在建模不精确的情况下仍能保持鲁棒性。该方法可显著缩小跨仿真器的性能差距，在Gazebo中实现高达92%的成功率，且在更严格阈值下仍保持69%的成功率，并无需额外调参即可成功迁移至真实机器人。

title: RoboStressBench: Benchmarking VLM Robustness to Physical Visual Stress in Embodied Scenes
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown strong visual understanding and are increasingly deployed in embodied AI systems, where reliable perception under real conditions is essential. However, existing benchmarks assess VLMs using clean images or isolated perturbations rather than stresses caused by physical scene formation. This design has two limitations: it covers only a narrow subset of everyday visual stresses, and some perturbations rarely appear in realistic embodied scenes. This gap raises a fundamental question: how can we define visual stress in a principled way that captures the diverse factors encountered in physical environments? To address this question, we formulate visual perception from an inverse graphics perspective and introduce RoboStressBench, a benchmark for evaluating VLM robustness to physical visual stress in embodied scenes. Inspired by the physical rendering equation, RoboStressBench decomposes visual stress into four physically grounded dimensions: Material (M), Viewpoint (V), Lighting (L), and Geometry (G). This design enables RoboStressBench to cover a broad range of visual stresses in real-world environments, while allowing controlled analysis of their effects on VLM capabilities such as visual recognition, reasoning, and planning. Through comprehensive evaluations of state-of-the-art VLMs, we identify stress-specific failure modes and reveal that different physical factors degrade different embodied capabilities, which are often obscured by aggregate accuracy. We further introduce a stress-aware agentic solver that detects visual stressors and invokes visual-editing skills before reasoning, improving robustness in high-stress scenarios. Overall, RoboStressBench provides a principled evaluation framework for diagnosing and improving VLM perception under real-world physical stress, supporting the development of more reliable embodied AI systems.
tldr: RoboStressBench introduces a physically grounded benchmark that decomposes visual stress into Material, Viewpoint, Lighting, and Geometry dimensions to evaluate VLM robustness in embodied scenes.
tldr_zh: RoboStressBench 提出一个基于物理的基准测试，将视觉压力分解为材质、视角、光照和几何四个维度，用于评估具身场景中 VLM 的鲁棒性。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）已展现出强大的视觉理解能力，并越来越多地被部署于具身AI系统中——在此类系统中，真实条件下的可靠感知至关重要。然而，现有基准测试仅使用干净图像或孤立扰动来评估VLM，而非由物理场景形成过程造成的应力。这种设计存在两个局限：其一仅覆盖日常视觉应力中的狭窄子集，其二某些扰动在实际具身场景中鲜少出现。该缺陷引出一个根本性问题：如何以原则性方式定义视觉应力，从而囊括物理环境中遭遇的各类因素？针对此问题，我们从逆向图形学视角构建视觉感知框架，并提出RoboStressBench——用于评估VLM在具身场景中应对物理视觉应力鲁棒性的基准测试。受物理渲染方程启发，RoboStressBench将视觉应力分解为四个物理基础维度：材质（M）、视角（V）、光照（L）与几何（G）。该设计使RoboStressBench既能覆盖真实环境中的广泛视觉应力，又可对VLM能力（如视觉识别、推理与规划）所受影响进行可控分析。通过全面评估当前最优VLM，我们识别出特定应力下的失效模式，并揭示不同物理因素会劣化不同的具身能力——这些现象往往被聚合准确率所掩盖。我们进一步提出应力感知型智能求解器，该方案在推理前检测视觉应力源并调用视觉编辑技能，从而提升高应力场景下的鲁棒性。总体而言，RoboStressBench为诊断与改进VLM在真实物理应力下的感知能力提供了原则性评估框架，助力开发更可靠的具身AI系统。

title: Shape-Prior-Based Point Cloud Completion for Single-Stage Fully Sparse 3D Object Detection
summary: Single-stage fully sparse 3D object detectors rely on point clouds data to detect objects in autonomous driving scenarios. However, the sparsity and incompleteness of point clouds significantly limit the performance of 3D object detection. To address this issue, this paper proposes a point clouds completion method specifically designed for single-stage fully sparse detectors. The entire shape-prior-based completion process consists of two consecutive steps. In the first step, we design a novel Instance Selection module, which is capable of identifying point clouds corresponding to foreground objects even when the baseline model does not generate proposals, while effectively ignoring the point clouds of background regions. In the second step, we introduce a novel Alignment-Based Point Completion module, which aligns the point clouds of foreground objects with prototypes in terms of both their centers and orientations. Subsequently, points are selected from the prototype to fill in the missing parts of the foreground object. We evaluated our method on two single-stage fully sparse detectors using the KITTI dataset. The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method significantly improves the detection performance, confirming its effectiveness and generalizability.
tldr: This paper proposes a shape-prior-based point cloud completion method to improve single-stage fully sparse 3D object detection in autonomous driving by identifying and completing foreground object points.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于形状先验的点云补全方法，通过识别并补全前景物体点云，提升自动驾驶中单阶段全稀疏3D目标检测的性能。
summary_zh: 单阶段全稀疏3D目标检测器依赖点云数据在自动驾驶场景中进行目标检测。然而，点云的稀疏性和不完整性严重制约了3D目标检测的性能。为解决这一问题，本文提出了一种专为单阶段全稀疏检测器设计的点云补全方法。基于形状先验的补全过程包含两个连续步骤：第一步，我们设计了一种新颖的实例选择模块，该模块能够在基线模型未生成候选框的情况下识别前景目标对应的点云，同时有效忽略背景区域的点云；第二步，我们引入了一种创新的基于对齐的点补全模块，该模块将前景目标的点云与原型在中心位置和朝向两方面进行对齐，随后从原型中选取点来填充前景目标的缺失部分。我们在KITTI数据集上使用两种单阶段全稀疏检测器评估了该方法。实验结果表明，所提方法显著提升了检测性能，验证了其有效性与泛化能力。

title: OptiWorld: Optimal Control for Video World Generation under Physical Constraints
summary: Video generation models are becoming a scalable form of world models, but they mainly generate plausible motion rather than proactively control or optimize the underlying dynamics. As a result, an object in the generated video may follow trajectories that are unsafe, not smooth, inefficient, or physically inconsistent. In this work, we propose \textbf{OptiWorld}, a framework that brings classical optimal control into video generation at inference time. OptiWorld first extracts a compact, task-relevant world state, then plans an optimal trajectory under physical constraints, and finally renders the video conditioned on this trajectory. We formulate planning as a geometric problem on a continuous manifold, which converts 3D geometry and task-dependent physical constraints into a unified planning geometry. By adding this optimal-control layer, OptiWorld generates videos with preferable dynamics, demonstrating strong potential in multiple tasks including goal-conditioned image-to-video generation, video dynamics editing, and counterfactual generation.
tldr: OptiWorld integrates classical optimal control with video generation to produce physically consistent videos by planning trajectories under constraints.
tldr_zh: OptiWorld将经典最优控制与视频生成相结合，通过约束下的轨迹规划生成物理一致的视频。
summary_zh: 视频生成模型正逐步成为世界模型的一种可扩展形式，但其主要生成看似合理的运动轨迹，而非主动控制或优化底层动力学。这导致生成的视频中物体可能呈现不安全的、非光滑的、低效的或与物理规律相悖的运动路径。本文提出 \textbf{OptiWorld} 框架，在推理阶段将经典最优控制融入视频生成。该框架首先提取紧凑且与任务相关世界状态，然后在物理约束下规划最优轨迹，最终基于该轨迹生成视频。我们将规划问题建模为连续流形上的几何问题，将三维几何和任务相关的物理约束转化为统一的规划几何空间。通过引入该最优控制层，OptiWorld 能够生成具有更优动力学的视频，在目标条件图像到视频生成、视频动力学编辑及反事实生成等多项任务中展现出强大潜力。

title: MUSCLE-NET: Predicted-Multiscale-Aware Network for Pedestrian Trajectory Forecasting
summary: Accurate pedestrian trajectory prediction is essential for safe navigation in autonomous driving and intelligent transportation systems. Despite substantial progress made by recent methods, most existing approaches are limited in fully exploiting diverse observations and often overlook the scale dependency of future motion, treating multiscale features uniformly regardless of underlying motion dynamics. This limits their robustness across diverse pedestrian behaviors. To address these challenges, we propose a Predicted-MUltiSCale-Aware Network (MUSCLE-NET) for Pedestrian Trajectory Forecasting that integrates complementary multimodal cues with scale-adaptive prediction mechanisms. The proposed framework is built upon a Multiscale Multimodal Feature Extraction (MMFE) module, which combines multiscale representation, modality-aware recalibration, and directional cross-modal fusion to construct semantically aligned representations from bounding boxes, velocities, and pose information. Building on these features, a Multiscale Enhanced Hierarchical Prediction (MEHP) module performs prediction-aware future-motion refinement via a probabilistic coarse predictor, scale-aligned fusion, and progressive refinement, adaptively selecting scale-relevant cues to mitigate spatial drift. Extensive experiments on the JAAD and PIE benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed MUSCLE-Net achieves competitive performance and consistent gains compared with state-of-the-art trajectory prediction methods.
tldr: MUSCLE-NET proposes a multiscale-aware pedestrian trajectory prediction network that integrates multimodal features (bounding boxes, velocities, pose) with scale-adaptive prediction mechanisms for autonomous driving.
tldr_zh: MUSCLE-NET 提出了一种多尺度感知的行人轨迹预测网络，通过整合多模态特征（边界框、速度、姿态）与尺度自适应预测机制，用于自动驾驶。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
准确的 pedestrian 轨迹预测对于自动驾驶和智能交通系统中的安全导航至关重要。尽管现有方法取得了显著进展，但大多数方法在充分利用多样化观察信息方面仍存在局限，且常忽视未来运动的尺度依赖性，对所有多尺度特征一视同仁，而不考虑底层运动动力学特性，这限制了其对多种 pedestrian 行为的鲁棒性。为解决这些问题，我们提出了一种面向 pedestrian 轨迹预测的预测感知多尺度融合网络（MUSCLE-NET），该网络将互补的多模态线索与尺度自适应预测机制相结合。所提出的框架基于多尺度多模态特征提取模块（MMFE）构建，该模块融合了多尺度表示、模态感知重标定与方向性跨模态融合，从边界框、速度及姿态信息中构建语义对齐的特征表示。在此特征基础上，多尺度增强层次化预测模块（MEHP）通过概率性粗预测器、尺度对齐融合及渐进细化机制实现预测感知的未来运动细化，自适应选择尺度相关线索以缓解空间漂移。在JAAD与PIE基准数据集上的大量实验表明，与当前最先进的轨迹预测方法相比，所提出的MUSCLE-Net取得了具有竞争力的性能与一致性的性能提升。

title: Behavior Cloning of MPC for 3-DOF Robotic Manipulators
summary: While Model Predictive Control (MPC) provides strong stability and robustness, it imposes a significant computational burden on real-time systems. This paper investigates the application of Behavior Cloning to approximate MPC policies for the real-time control of a 3-degree-of-freedom robotic manipulator. We present a baseline controller combining Inverse Kinematics with MPC and evaluate neural network architectures, ranging from classical regression algorithms to deep learning models including Deep MLPs and RNNs, to derive computationally efficient surrogate policies. We analyze generalization capabilities, stability considerations, and the trade-offs inherent in different architectural choices. Our empirical study employs both online and offline evaluations to assess performance regarding accuracy, computational efficiency, and fidelity to the original MPC policy. Our results demonstrate that Behavior Cloning can effectively reduce the computational burden of MPC policies for 3-DOF robotic manipulators, achieving a 3x reduction in inference latency with a 84.98% success rate under relaxed tolerances. Notably, we find that static architectures outperform temporal variants, confirming the sufficiency of instantaneous state observations for this task. However, we observe a precision gap under strict tolerances, which suggest that while Behavior Cloning captures the global optimal trajectory, further research is needed to minimize terminal steady-state error.
tldr: This paper uses behavior cloning to approximate an MPC policy for a 3-DOF robotic manipulator, achieving a 3x reduction in inference latency with 84.98% task success under relaxed tolerances, and finds that static architectures outperform temporal ones.
tldr_zh: 本文使用行为克隆近似3自由度机械臂的MPC策略，在宽松容差下实现了3倍推理加速和84.98%的任务成功率，并发现静态架构优于时序架构。
summary_zh: 模型预测控制（MPC）虽能提供强大的稳定性与鲁棒性，但会对实时系统造成显著的计算负担。本文研究了如何应用行为克隆来近似MPC策略，以实现三自由度机器人操作臂的实时控制。我们提出了一种结合逆运动学与MPC的基线控制器，并评估了从经典回归算法到深度MLP和RNN等深度学习模型在内的多种神经网络架构，以导出计算高效的替代策略。我们分析了泛化能力、稳定性问题以及不同架构选择内在的权衡关系。实证研究采用在线与离线两种评估方式，从准确性、计算效率及对原始MPC策略的保真度三个维度评价性能。结果表明，行为克隆能有效降低三自由度机械臂MPC策略的计算负担：在放宽容差下，推理延迟降低3倍，成功率达84.98%。值得注意的是，静态架构的表现优于时序变体，证实了瞬时状态观测足以胜任此任务。然而，在严格容差下我们观察到精度差距，这表明虽然行为克隆能捕获全局最优轨迹，但仍需进一步研究以最小化终端稳态误差。

title: Belief Consistency Between Foundation-Model Evidence and Geometric Perception in Persistent Robotic Maps
summary: Persistent maps used by autonomous robots increasingly fuse a geometric perception stack whose assertions are well-characterized with a foundation-model channel that produces semantic claims without calibrated reliability about the same scene. Contemporary mapping systems integrate the two channels by treating the foundation-model channel as an additional voter into a per-element posterior, uncalibrated for its own per-class reliability and without machinery to flag when the two channels contradict each other at a given moment. We propose an update operator with two cooperating mechanisms: a per-class calibrated commit gate, and a per-event conflict-drop window that refuses to commit foundation-model claims contradicted by the geometric channel at the moment of the claim. We evaluate on KITTI-360 and ScanNet, with an oracle geometric channel (panoptic ground truth) and an off-the-shelf online semantic segmenter (Mask2Former) to demonstrate real-world performance. The operator produces substantially more accurate committed maps (KITTI is car commit precision 99.7% vs. 43.9% for the calibration-only operator; mean per-class IoU 0.522 vs. 0.180), retains more compositional true positives at higher precision than a monolithic compositional VLM prompt. The framework operates at deployment quality across both oracle and off-the-shelf-segmenter geometric channels, and is invariant under foundation-model substitution.
tldr: Proposes a new mapping update operator that fuses geometric perception with foundation-model semantic outputs by adding a per-class calibrated commit gate and a conflict-drop window, significantly improving map accuracy on KITTI-360 and ScanNet.
tldr_zh: 提出一种新的地图更新算子，结合几何感知与基础模型的语义输出，通过添加每类校准提交门和冲突丢弃窗口，显著提升KITTI-360和ScanNet上的地图精度。
summary_zh: 自主机器人所使用的持久地图正日益融合几何感知通道（其断言具有良好特征）与基础模型通道（能在无校准可靠性的情况下对同一场景生成语义断言）两套系统。当代建图系统通过将基础模型通道作为每个元素后验的附加投票者来整合这两个通道，但未针对其逐类可靠性进行校准，也缺乏在特定时刻两个通道相互矛盾时发出标记的机制。我们提出一种包含两种协作机制的更新算子：逐类校准提交门控，以及逐事件冲突丢弃窗口——该窗口拒绝提交与几何通道在断言时刻产生矛盾的基础模型断言。我们采用KITTI-360和ScanNet数据集进行评估，使用神谕几何通道（全景真值）与现成在线语义分割器（Mask2Former）来验证实际性能。该算子生成的提交地图精度显著更高（KITTI数据集：车辆类提交精度99.7%，而仅校准算子为43.9%；平均每类IoU为0.522对比0.180），在保持更高精度的前提下，保留了比单一组合式VLM提示更多的合成真阳性。该框架在神谕式几何通道与现成分割器几何通道上均能达到部署级质量，且对基础模型替换具有不变性。

title: Infeasible optimization problems and the hierarchical augmented Lagrangian method in imitation learning
summary: Imitation learning (IL) is an effective approach to train complex robotics policies. Recent works have introduced hard constraints into imitation-learning optimization problems to ensure safety, stability, and robustness of the learned policy. However, we argue that these constraints are sometimes infeasible, which can lead to unstable or difficult training dynamics. We study a simple remedy for such situations based on recent theoretical results on the augmented Lagrangian method in infeasible settings. We show that our approach drives the learned policy toward the solution of a closest-feasible constrained IL problem with desirable properties. The method is illustrated on a toy driving example with a total-acceleration constraint and pedestrian-safety constraints, a setting in which infeasibility can naturally arise while still allowing a safe learned policy.
tldr: This paper addresses infeasibility in constrained imitation learning for robotics by applying the hierarchical augmented Lagrangian method to drive the policy toward the closest feasible solution, demonstrated on a toy driving example with safety constraints.
tldr_zh: 本文针对机器人模仿学习中约束不可行的问题，采用层次增广拉格朗日方法将策略推向最接近的可行解，并通过一个带行人安全约束的驾驶示例进行验证。

title: ScaRF-SLAM: Scale-Consistent Reconstruction with Feed-Forward Models and Classical Visual SLAM
summary: Recent works have explored unifying SLAM with geometric foundation models (GFMs). However, directly using GFM predictions for tracking is highly sensitive to model capability and uncertainty, as geometric inaccuracies in the predictions can adversely affect pose estimation. To address this limitation, we present a decoupled framework that integrates classical feature-based SLAM with GFMs, which achieves higher quality and more consistent dense reconstruction. In brief, we use classical visual SLAM for robust low-latency tracking and use GFMs exclusively for mapping. By anchoring mapping to poses produced by the SLAM module and optimizing across depth scales, the proposed design avoids propagating inaccuracies from GFM predictions into pose estimation while imposing geometric constraints on the reconstruction. The system builds submaps from multiple posed keyframes and enforces scale consistency via lightweight frame and submap scale optimization. It also performs projection-based point cloud fusion within each submap, and updates submaps online to reflect trajectory updates from the feature-based SLAM. To evaluate tracking and reconstruction of our method, we introduce a loop-rich, building-scale indoor dataset with accurate sensor trajectories and LiDAR ground-truth. Experiments show that our approach achieves superior trajectory accuracy while improving reconstruction precision by 10%-20% over existing methods, with about 2 cm reconstruction error per 10 m chunk on building-scale dataset. On large-scale outdoor datasets, it attains 10 cm error per 30 m chunk (w.r.t LiDAR ground-truth models).
tldr: ScaRF-SLAM combines classical feature-based visual SLAM with geometric foundation models (GFMs) for robust low-latency tracking and high-quality dense reconstruction, achieving superior trajectory accuracy and reconstruction precision on indoor and outdoor datasets.
tldr_zh: ScaRF-SLAM 将经典特征基视觉 SLAM 与几何基础模型 (GFM) 相结合，实现了稳健的低延迟跟踪和高质量密集重建，在室内外数据集上取得了更优的轨迹精度和重建精度。

title: Behavior-Invariant Task Representation Learning with Transformer-based World Models for Offline Meta-Reinforcement Learning
summary: Offline meta-reinforcement learning leverages static datasets to enable agents to generalize to unseen environments by combining offline efficiency with meta-learning adaptability, yet it faces key challenges from context and policy distribution shifts. These issues hinder agents from adapting to online environments, and are further exacerbated under sparse-reward settings. As a result, agents often become trapped in an inherent pattern dilemma, failing to achieve robust generalization. In this work, we propose a novel framework that integrates information-theoretic task representation learning with a Transformer-based stochastic world model. Our approach extracts task-defining latent variables that are invariant to behavior policy, thereby effectively mitigating the context distribution shift. To further handle policy shift and model exploitation, we apply a conservative value penalty to imagination-based rollouts, preventing the policy from exploiting model inaccuracies while maintaining robust adaptation. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that our method outperforms state-of-the-art approaches, with superior stability and generalization under out-of-distribution and sparse-reward settings.
tldr: This paper proposes a framework that combines information-theoretic task representation learning with a Transformer-based stochastic world model to address context and policy distribution shifts in offline meta-reinforcement learning.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个结合信息论任务表示学习和基于Transformer的随机世界模型的框架，以解决离线元强化学习中的上下文和策略分布偏移问题。

title: BEVIO: Efficient Bird's-Eye-View based Sparse-Update Visual-Inertial Odometry for Lunar Day-Night Navigation
summary: Visual-Inertial Odometry (VIO) provides smooth, high-rate state estimates and has been widely used for robotic navigation in both terrestrial and planetary applications. However, its performance is typically dependent on the frequency of visual updates, which is a challenge for planetary rovers operating under extreme resource constraints and low frame rates. This work investigates enabling reliable VIO with very sparse visual updates for lunar rover applications, addressing both day and night-time operations where feature associations become especially difficult under self-illumination conditions. We propose a Bird's Eye View (BEV)-based image matching scheme that remains robust to larger inter-frame motions and more reliable feature matching despite significant visual appearance changes. We extensively evaluate our proposed approach, BEVIO, through high-fidelity photorealistic lunar and real-time robotic experiments conducted using a half-scale lunar rover, in a long-term day-night deployment at Plaster City, CA, USA. The results demonstrate that our method enables reliable day and nighttime self-illuminated traverses at visual update rates as low as 0.25 Hz, underscoring its suitability for navigation on power- and compute-limited lunar rovers.
tldr: Introduces BEVIO, a sparse-update visual-inertial odometry with a Bird's-Eye-View matching scheme that enables reliable lunar rover navigation at extremely low visual update rates (0.25 Hz) in both day and self-illuminated night conditions.
tldr_zh: 提出BEVIO，一种基于鸟瞰图的稀疏更新视觉-惯性里程计方法，在极低视觉更新率（0.25 Hz）下实现月球车在白天和自照明夜间的可靠导航。

title: Edge-Based QoS-Aware Adaptive Task Placement: A Closed-Loop Control in Multi-Robot Systems
summary: Multi-robot systems (MRS) increasingly offload compute-intensive perception tasks to edge nodes to meet strict time-sensitive Quality-of-Service (QoS) constraints. However, static task orchestration on a shared edge node can severely degrade QoS due to network latency, jitter, and edge-resource contention. We present a pilot edge-centric MRS testbed using Raspberry Pi nodes to evaluate a camera-to-manipulator pipeline under three modes: local execution, static offloading, and a QoS-aware Adaptive Task Placement (ATP) controller. ATP scores candidate placements using a multi-metric cost (normalized latency, CPU utilization, and switching overhead) over two-second control windows. The closed-loop visual servoing testbed is instrumented with sub-millisecond clock synchronization, network emulation, and detailed monitoring of multiple metrics across nodes to capture realistic jitter. Experimental results under compute-stress and network-fault scenarios show that static edge offloading reduces on-board CPU load but amplifies tail latency and deadline misses. In contrast, the QoS-aware ATP controller, by switching task placement based on measured latency and utilization thresholds, consistently lowers deadline violations and tail latency. Overall, the results position ATP as a practical edge-side control primitive for MRS and concrete design guidelines for Cloud-Edge Robotics deployments within the broader cloud-fog automation, while motivating QoS-aware multi-objective workload orchestration for industrial cyber-physical systems.
tldr: This paper presents a QoS-aware adaptive task placement (ATP) controller for multi-robot systems, using closed-loop control to dynamically decide between local execution and edge offloading based on latency and utilization thresholds, validated on a Raspberry Pi testbed with a camera-to-manipulator pipeline.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种面向多机器人系统的QoS自适应任务放置（ATP）控制器，通过闭环控制基于延迟和利用率阈值动态决定本地执行或边缘卸载，并在树莓派测试平台上通过相机到机械臂的流水线进行了验证。

title: Adaptive PD Gains for Energy-Conscious Control in Physical Human-Robot Interaction
summary: Compliant force or torque control are approaches often investigated to achieve safe physical human-robot interaction (pHRI). However, these approaches have limitations. Force control requires a robot to be equipped with external force sensors to track the amplitude and direction of applied forces. Torque control requires torque sensing or estimation in each joint. As this is not available on every robot, energy-based approaches offer a promising alternative. Such approaches aim to achieve safe pHRI by limiting the mechanical energy of the robot. Current schemes leveraging an energy-based approach tend to have a complex implementation, and some may require further stability verification. We hence propose an adaptive proportional-derivative (PD) controller that can limit a robot's energy under any given limit to achieve safe pHRI. The proposed controller can limit both the kinetic and potential energy of a robot, and the behaviour of the controller gains can be shaped using various parameters, defining precisely the cutoff limit and sharpness. We construct a stability proof for the controller and define a condition to ensure the controller's stability. The proposed controller's behaviour and compliance are tested on the TALOS robot from PAL Robotics both in simulation and on hardware, verifying the expected compliant and energy-limiting behaviour of the controller.
tldr: This paper proposes an adaptive PD controller that limits a robot's kinetic and potential energy to achieve safe physical human-robot interaction, with stability proof and validation on a TALOS robot.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种自适应PD控制器，通过限制机器人的动能和势能来实现安全的人机物理交互，并提供了稳定性证明以及在TALOS机器人上的仿真与硬件验证。

title: Predicted-Flow Control Barrier Functions for Real-Time Safe Optimal Control
summary: Control barrier functions (CBFs) provide real-time safety guarantees through pointwise conditions on the state. However, synthesizing a valid CBF is difficult and the resulting controllers are myopic. To address myopia, this article introduces predicted-flow control barrier functions (P-CBFs), which generalize the CBF from a function of the current state to a functional of a predicted flow under a parametrized control plan over a finite prediction horizon. For safety, a P-CBF can certify that the predicted flow is in a safe set over the entire prediction horizon. However, candidate P-CBFs suffer from the same challenge as candidate CBFs, namely, control constraints make it difficult to guarantee that the P-CBF is valid. This article resolves this challenge by introducing a terminal candidate P-CBF requiring that the predicted flow end in a backup safe set at the terminal time, and a planning-time shift that modulates the prediction horizon, providing an additional degree of freedom to ensure feasibility. The real-time control and the evolution of the control-plan parameter and planning-time shift are determined jointly by a single convex optimization that is guaranteed to be feasible and renders the associated safe set forward invariant. The resulting safe optimal flow control provides a safety certificate over the entire prediction horizon and unifies finite-horizon integral-cost optimization with safety certification. This optimization reduces to a quadratic program (QP) if the control constraints are a convex polytope. The QP implementation, termed FlowBarrier, is validated on a nonholonomic ground robot navigating a dense environment. FlowBarrier is compared to nonlinear model predictive control and two CBF-based safety filter methods across 100 trials, where FlowBarrier achieves the highest goal-reaching rate, zero safety violations, and the lowest computation time.
tldr: This paper introduces predicted-flow control barrier functions (P-CBFs) that generalize CBFs to certify safety over a finite prediction horizon, and formulates a convex optimization that unifies safety certification with optimal control, validated on a nonholonomic ground robot.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了预测流控制障碍函数（P-CBF），将CBF推广到在有限预测时域内认证安全性，并构建了一个凸优化问题，将安全认证与最优控制统一起来，在非完整地面机器人上进行了验证。

title: A Four-Tier Communication Architecture and Sim-to-Real Validation of a Graphical Open-Source Platform for Robotic Engineering Education
summary: The persistent challenge in scaling authentic manipulator education within university laboratories is a structural dichotomy: commercial digital twins are often cost-prohibitive and rigidly scripted, whereas open-source robotics middleware (ROS) imposes steep technical and syntax barriers for novices. To resolve this logistical and educational friction, this Work-in-Progress (WiP) paper proposes a scalable four-tier communication architecture tailored for sustainable robotic curricula. Rather than focusing on software application design, our study examines the underlying data exchange mechanisms required to bridge visual conceptual environments with physical robotic endpoints, utilizing the Graphical Open-Source Platform (GOSP) as a foundational instantiation. This WiP details the framework's technical integration of 3D visual armature modeling with a robust ROS middleware backend, emphasizing the serialization, routing, and encapsulation of intricate communication routines. Preliminary sim-to-real validation using multi-axis spatial trajectories confirms that encapsulating these communication pipelines provides a sufficient fidelity hardware-agnostic pathway. By bridging virtual design and physical execution, this architectural blueprint offers a viable infrastructure for engineering education.
tldr: This paper presents a four-tier communication architecture using a Graphical Open-Source Platform (GOSP) to bridge virtual design and physical robotic execution for educational purposes, with sim-to-real validation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种四层通信架构，利用图形化开源平台（GOSP）连接虚拟设计与物理机器人执行，并通过仿真到现实的验证用于工程教育。

title: Literary Emotions in Motion: A Soft Robotics Installation for Tactile Storytelling
summary: Soft robotics is increasingly explored in artistic contexts, where tactile interaction provides audiences with embodied engagement beyond visual or auditory signals. This work presents an interactive installation that maps semantic emotion analysis of narrative text into variable stiffness of soft pneumatic modules. A natural language model identifies two dominant emotions from a predefined set of six, driving the inflation of seven hexagonally arranged soft actuators. The central actuator represents the primary emotion, while the surrounding ones express the secondary. We develop and mechanically characterize silicone actuators, called soft modules, featuring a thin membrane layer, demonstrating how this morphological control expands the achievable stiffness range while preserving simplicity and low-cost fabrication. A user study with ten participants further evaluates how multisensory coupling of stiffness and LEDs intensity influences emotional perception.
